description: Onyxia's drops that a quest takes, for the guild Loot tab's collapsed line (design/specs/2026-11-05-guild-loot.md §3.6). Every quest id and name is read from cmangos/classic-db commit ec4f596146be6467ea93c57397858e329e2db852 (Full_DB/ClassicDB_1_12_1_z2815.sql.gz), the dump pipeline.classic_quest_levels pins. class is the quest's RequiredClasses as a class slug, faction its RequiredRaces side; null when the quest has none. api/internal/guilds/loot_quests.go copies this table and a test pins the two.
